errors.description: The silk/bemberg facing-lining panel carries a fairly high specular sheen in the central highlight, which in the brightest band reads slightly satin-synthetic rather than woven.
errors.expected: Luxury bemberg/silk lining with a soft, diffuse sheen and visible weave micro-texture throughout.
errors.actual: Continuous smooth panel with a broad glossy highlight through the centre; weave micro-texture is only faintly readable there.
errors.correction: Non-blocking. If ever re-shot, soften the key light or add a scrim to reduce the central specular band on the lining.

lockedFeatures: interior orientation confirmed — jacket opened, shell facing strip along the front edge, lining panel inboard, second lining layer behind at left

pen pocket ABSENT — no welt, no jet, no double-jet slot, no piping, no teardrop or diamond opening, no pocket slot and no pocket button anywhere in frame (verified at full frame plus top and bottom zoom crops)
no sibling-option geometry: nothing resembling pen-left-jetted, pen-*-drop or pen-*-diamond appears
the clean, unbroken pocket-free facing/lining panel is the dominant subject, roughly half the frame, fully contained with nothing confusingly bisected
seamless neutral light-grey studio background; no location, architecture, furniture, scenery or props
zero text, numbers, units, arrows, leader lines, dimension marks, ruler ticks, callouts or watermark anywhere in frame
photorealistic: hopsack shell weave legible, hand pick-stitching along the facing/lining seam and around the rounded front quarter and hem
the two buttonholes on the shell front edge are the jacket's own front-closure buttonholes — legitimate forepart construction, not pocket geometry
notes: Attempt 2 after a FAIL on attempt 1. Blueprint (public/images/jacket/pen-pocket/none.jpg, 240x200 crop of the interior chest area) shows a diagonal double edge line, small round marks at lower left, and NO pen pocket — consistent with label 'None' / 'No pen pocket.', so the consistency gate passed and no BLUEPRINT_CONFLICT was raised. The photo reproduces exactly that: an interior face with a diagonal pick-stitched facing edge, small round buttonhole features on that edge, and a continuous pocket-free panel. Attempt 1's blocking defects are both resolved: the hallucinated interior jetted double-welt pocket and its button are gone, and the extreme macro crop has been pulled back so the opened interior reads as a sport coat interior within one second. Only a minor lighting/material nit remains (specular sheen on the lining highlight), which does not affect option identification.
